description.zh-CN: 左下角的聊天行一条条出现，每行带半透明黑底，新的把旧的顶上去，过一会儿淡出；可以先在输入栏里一个字一个字打出第一条再发出。
description.en: Chat lines appear one by one at the lower left, each on a translucent black strip, pushing older lines up and fading after a while; the first one can be typed into the input bar before it is sent.

hint.zh-CN: Java 版的聊天栏。基岩版的聊天（会压暗背景的界面）没有做
hint.en: The Java chat. The Bedrock chat (a screen that dims the background) is not implemented

hint.zh-CN: 一行一条，最多 12 条。可以用 § 或 & 加格式码换颜色（如 §e 黄色、§a 绿色、§l 粗体）；带格式码的一行不会自动换行
hint.en: One message per line, up to 12. Use § or & format codes for color (§e yellow, §a green, §l bold); a line with format codes does not wrap

default.zh-CN:
<Alex> 有人在吗？
<Steve> 来了来了
§eSunny加入了游戏
default.en:
<Alex> anyone here?
<Steve> on my way
§eSunny joined the game

hint.zh-CN: 相邻两条消息出现的时间差
hint.en: Time between one message and the next

hint.zh-CN: 每条消息从出现到消失的时间，最后十分之一淡出；游戏里是 200 刻（10 秒）
hint.en: How long each message stays, fading over its last tenth; 200 ticks (10 s) in the game

hint.zh-CN: 开头显示聊天输入栏，把第一条消息一个字一个字打出来（不含开头的 <名字>，最多 48 个字），停一下后发出
hint.en: Opens the chat input bar and types the first message character by character (without the leading <name>, up to 48 characters), then sends it after a short pause

hint.zh-CN: 没有格式码的文字的颜色
hint.en: Color of text without format codes

hint.zh-CN: 游戏里聊天文字带阴影
hint.en: Chat text has a shadow in the game

hint.zh-CN: 每行后面黑底的不透明度，输入栏也用它；游戏里的默认值是 50%
hint.en: Opacity of the black strip behind each line and of the input bar; 50% by default in the game

hint.zh-CN: 一个界面像素对应的设计单位（1080p 的游戏窗口在自动缩放下是 4）；画面放不下 332 个界面像素宽的聊天栏时自动缩小
hint.en: Design units per GUI pixel (4 for a 1080p window at Auto); shrinks automatically when the 332-pixel-wide chat does not fit

hint.zh-CN: 整体淡入。游戏里聊天是直接出现的，这里淡入是为了盖到视频上时不突兀
hint.en: Overall fade in. The game shows chat instantly; the fade keeps the overlay from popping onto the footage

hint.zh-CN: 消息在这段时间里按间隔出现；比消息显示时间长时，消息会自己先淡出
hint.en: Messages appear during this time; if it is longer than the message lifetime the messages fade out on their own first

hint.zh-CN: 整体淡出，还没到时间的消息在这里一起消失
hint.en: Overall fade out; messages still showing disappear here together

hint.zh-CN: 每条消息出现时播放。游戏里收到聊天没有声音；创作者常用音符盒的“叮”（minecraft:block.note_block.pling）
hint.en: Plays when each message appears. The game has no chat sound; creators often use the note block pling (minecraft:block.note_block.pling)

name.zh-CN: 游戏原始时长（10 秒后淡出）
